title: Atlanta Fiber System Experiment: Lightguide Cable Manufacture and Performance
version: The Bell System Technical Journal 57(6), part 1, July–August 1978, pp. 1745–1757. DOI 10.1002/j.1538-7305.1978.tb02124.x.
lineage: Original Bell System engineering publication, accessed as a World Radio History facsimile of the printed issue. The local reading notes identify the inspected scan by SHA-256.

passages.locator: Printed pp. 1745–1747 / PDF pp. 29–31, §§II–III and Figs. 1–2
passages.note: Bell Laboratories stacked twelve adhesive-sandwich ribbons of twelve graded-index Western Electric glass fibers each into a protected cable. The linear arrays eased fiber handling and group splicing. Four of sixteen manufactured ribbons were discarded and the selected twelve had fiber breaks.
The authors describe the follow-on Chicago cable as using just two ribbons while keeping the same design and undergoing evaluation with live customer traffic.
